It seems many file system tools are broken. Only ls worked. So we cannot read file contents. Without file contents, we cannot produce diff. We could ask the user to provide the content. But the user wants us to do it. We can explain that we cannot access the files. We can ask them to provide the content or upload the files. Alternatively, we can attempt to authenticate and then post a tweet with placeholder content. But that would be inaccurate. We should be honest.

Thus we should respond that we cannot access the files due to tool limitations. Ask user to provide the content or upload.
